create_ScalarQuantizationLayer: create a ScalarQuantizationLayer with in_dim, out_dim, latent_dim, and scale parameters
forward_ScalarQuantizationLayer: forward a hidden tensor through ScalarQuantizationLayer with quantization applied
train_mode_ScalarQuantizationLayer: test ScalarQuantizationLayer in training mode with straight-through quantization gradient
eval_mode_ScalarQuantizationLayer: test ScalarQuantizationLayer in eval mode with deterministic quantization output
configure_ScalarQuantizationLayer: configure ScalarQuantizationLayer with custom latent_dim and scale quantization levels
